_note: Recurring-problem themes for harvest.py clusters. First theme with the most regex hits wins. Add a theme when 2+ frictions share a cause no theme names; keep fix hints to one minimal change.

themes.title: Scripts leave __pycache__ in the skill folder
themes.fix: Put `import sys; sys.dont_write_bytecode = True` before local imports in every entry script; add a hygiene eval.

themes.title: Canon writes lack a dry-run or sandbox route (trials, parallel lanes)
themes.fix: Name `bible.py ... --dry-run` plus the OQ-TBD-<slug> placeholder rule in the one step that records canon.

themes.title: Open-question ids collide, go stale or are hard-coded
themes.fix: Cite OQ ids read at run time (`bible get questions --json`), check the title matches, never keep an OQ list in code.

themes.title: Critic independence and route when no Agent tool (self-review, remote, handoff)
themes.fix: One probe order in rr-mission-control, referenced (not restated) by every maker skill; never certify self scores.

themes.title: Relative paths leak into prompts and handoffs
themes.fix: Resolve every path to absolute before printing it into a spawn prompt or brief.

themes.title: Workflow tells missions to edit the shared skill instead of a mission copy
themes.fix: Default every write to the mission copy (env override such as RR_<X>_PRESETS); the skill folder is read-only at run time.

themes.title: Critic evidence misses part of the deliverable (one close-up, hero only, no tiles)
themes.fix: Let the brief carry every deliverable (or a second evidence sheet) and label tiles; add an eval that counts deliverables vs tiles.

themes.title: No path for jobs with several deliverables (screens, variants, effects, looks)
themes.fix: Accept a list of names end to end (render, sheet, crit, export) and test it with 2+ items.

themes.title: Generated critic brief is generic instead of job-specific
themes.fix: Fill Purpose/audience from the job (mission R-lines or --purpose), and refuse a brief that still holds a placeholder.

themes.title: Skill values contradict canon (numbers, gauge, colours, strings)
themes.fix: Read the value from rr-bible at run time (key cited), and add a drift.py check or a `check:` regex to the fact.

themes.title: Silent success or false PASS hides a problem
themes.fix: Fail loudly (non-zero exit, named item) and add the case to the selftest.

themes.title: A checker measures the wrong thing
themes.fix: Measure the delivered result (per piece / per frame) and plant a known-bad case in the selftest.

themes.title: Output or docs spend tokens for nothing
themes.fix: Print a summary by default (--full for the rest); read slices, not whole files.

themes.title: Workspace root or path convention is ambiguous
themes.fix: One env var + flag per root, recorded in state; resume reads it back.

themes.title: Tool missing in the cloud image; no documented fallback
themes.fix: Name the cloud fallback (and its limits) next to the preferred tool.

themes.title: Owner-away or gated-run behaviour undefined
themes.fix: State the default (proceed on best match, persist questions to the mission file, mark fallback).

themes.title: Token or cost numbers are estimated but not labelled
themes.fix: Label every non-measured token figure est. in ledgers and debriefs (a flag on the logging command).
